name: Sashiko
description: Sashiko running stitch: even dashes lying flat along one row and upright on the next, quilting a grid.

code.style: --rule: ( @random(${shapeFrequency}) { :before { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 8%; top: 46%; width: 36%; height: 8%; background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } :after { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 56%; top: 46%; width: 36%; height: 8%; background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } @match(@y % 2 == 1) { :before { left: 46%; top: 8%; width: 8%; height: 36%; } :after { left: 46%; top: 56%; width: 8%; height: 36%; } } } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
